actions.description: Add a comment to an epic.
actions.name: create-epic-comment

epic_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Epic. Example: 16

text.description: The comment text. Markdown is supported.

milestone_id.description: Objective (milestone) ID to link the epic to. Example: 14

owner_ids.description: Array of member UUIDs to assign as owners.

label_ids.description: Array of label IDs to attach.

deadline.description: Deadline date as ISO-8601 string. Example: "2026-12-31"

planned_start_date.description: Planned start date as ISO-8601 string. Example: "2026-07-01"

name.description: The name of the iteration. Example: "Sprint 1"

start_date.description: The start date of the iteration in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example: "2026-07-15"

end_date.description: The end date of the iteration in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be after start_date. Example: "2026-07-28"

group_ids.description: Optional array of group (team) IDs to associate with the iteration.

name.description: Label name. Must be unique within the workspace.

actions.description: Attach a URL-based linked file. Associate it with stories afterward via update-story's linked_file_ids.
actions.name: create-linked-file

name.description: Name of the linked file. Example: "Design Spec"

url.description: URL of the linked file. Example: "https://example.com/doc"

name.description: The name of the Milestone. Example: "Q3 Objective"

categories.description: Array of category names to attach to the Milestone. Example: ["Q3 Goals"]

started_at_override.description: Manual override for the time/date the Milestone was started. ISO 8601 format.

completed_at_override.description: Manual override for the time/date the Milestone was completed. ISO 8601 format.

actions.description: Add a comment to a story.
actions.name: create-story-comment

story_public_id.description: The public ID of the story to comment on. Example: 35

text.description: Comment text, supporting Markdown and @mentions via member UUIDs. Example: "Great work!"

parent_id.description: The ID of an existing comment to reply to, creating a thread. Example: 37

actions.description: Link two stories with a relationship verb (blocks, duplicates, relates to).
actions.name: create-story-link

subject_id.description: The ID of the story doing the linking. Example: 33

object_id.description: The ID of the story being linked to. Example: 34

actions.description: Add a checklist task to a story
actions.name: create-story-task

story_public_id.description: The story public ID to add the task to. Example: 35

description.description: The task description. Example: "Review design mockups"

complete.description: Whether the task is complete. Defaults to false.

owner_ids.description: UUIDs of members to assign as owners. Example: ["6a53bda8-4df3-4862-baf5-bf953f932636"]

position.description: The task position within the story.

workflow_state_id.description: Workflow state ID. Example: 500000007. If omitted along with project_id, the workspace default workflow state is used.

owner_ids.description: Member UUIDs who own the story.

estimate.description: Point estimate (only meaningful for feature stories).

custom_field_id.description: The unique ID of the custom field to delete. Example: "6a53c255-dbbc-4bc8-8b96-a982e615f120"

epic_public_id.description: The public ID of the epic to delete. Example: 26

iteration_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Iteration. Example: 28

linked_file_id.description: The ID of the linked file to delete. Example: 46

milestone_id.description: The unique ID of the Milestone (Objective) to delete. Example: 43

actions.description: Delete a comment from a story.

story_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Story. Example: 35

comment_id.description: The unique ID of the Comment. Example: 37

actions.description: Remove a link between two stories.
actions.name: delete-story-link

story_link_public_id.description: The unique public ID of the story link to delete. Example: 500000019

actions.description: Delete a task from a story.
actions.name: delete-story-task

story_public_id.description: The unique ID of the story containing the task. Example: 35

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to delete. Example: 39

story_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Story. Example: 33

epic_id.description: The unique public ID of the epic. Example: 16

story_public_id.description: The public ID of the story. Example: 35

query.description: Shortcut search query using search-operator syntax. When provided, the paginated /search/epics endpoint is used.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search response. Only used when query is also provided.

next.description: Pagination cursor when using the search endpoint. Omitted when listing all epics or when there are no more search results.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. The /groups endpoint does not support cursor pagination; this field is reserved for future use.

next_cursor.description: The /groups endpoint does not return a cursor; this field is reserved for future use.

slim.description: When true, omits the per-label stats object for a lighter payload.

id.description: The unique identifier for the file. Example: 123

name.description: The name of the linked file.

content_type.description: The content type of the image (e.g. text/plain).

created_at.description: The time/date the LinkedFile was created.

updated_at.description: The time/date the LinkedFile was updated.

entity_type.description: A string description of this resource.

group_mention_ids.description: The groups that are mentioned in the description of the file.

member_mention_ids.description: The members that are mentioned in the description of the file.

size.description: The filesize, if the integration provided it.

story_ids.description: The IDs of the stories this file is attached to.

thumbnail_url.description: The URL of the file thumbnail, if the integration provided it.

uploader_id.description: The UUID of the member that uploaded the file.

slim.description: Return a lighter payload with fewer fields per member.

actions.description: List Objectives (called milestones in the Shortcut API).
actions.name: list-milestones

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. The /milestones endpoint does not support cursor pagination; this field is reserved for future use.

next_cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page. The /milestones endpoint does not return a cursor; this field is reserved for future use.

actions.description: List projects — a deprecated, pre-Epics/Groups feature.
actions.name: list-projects

cursor.description: Pagination cursor. Not used because the Shortcut Projects endpoint does not support pagination.

query.description: Simple text query for GET /search/stories using Shortcut search-operator syntax. When provided, the structured filters below are ignored.

story_type.description: Filter by a single story type.

updated_at_start.description: Stories updated on or after this ISO 8601 date.

updated_at_end.description: Stories updated on or before this ISO 8601 date.

created_at_start.description: Stories created on or after this ISO 8601 date.

created_at_end.description: Stories created on or before this ISO 8601 date.

includes_description.description: Include story description in the response.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Only used with `query` (GET /search/stories); ignored otherwise.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response (`next` field). Only used with `query` (GET /search/stories) — the structured-filter search (POST /stories/search) returns the full result set with no pagination support and ignores this field.

actions.description: List story workflows and their states.
actions.name: list-workflows

epic_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Epic. Example: 16

iteration_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Iteration. Example: 28

description.description: The description of the Iteration. Set to null to clear.

start_date.description: The date this Iteration begins. Example: "2026-07-12"

end_date.description: The date this Iteration ends. Example: "2026-07-19"

group_ids.description: An array of UUIDs for any Groups you want to add as Followers.

id.description: The unique ID of the label to update. Example: 7

milestone_id.description: The ID of the Milestone. Example: 15

categories.description: An array of category names to attach to the Milestone. Example: ["Q3 Goals"]

actions.description: Update or complete a task on a story.
actions.name: update-story-task

story_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Story. Example: 35

task_id.description: The unique ID of the Task. Example: 39

description.description: The new description of the Task.

complete.description: Whether the Task is completed. Setting true stamps completed_at server-side.

owner_ids.description: Array of UUIDs for any members to add as Owners on this Task.

before_id.description: The ID of the Task we want to move this Task before.

after_id.description: The ID of the Task we want to move this Task after.

story_public_id.description: The unique ID of the Story to update. Example: 35

workflow_state_id.description: The ID of the workflow state to put the story in.

epic_id.description: The ID of the epic the story belongs to.

iteration_id.description: The ID of the iteration the story belongs to.

owner_ids.description: An array of UUIDs of the owners of this story.

label_ids.description: An array of label ids attached to the story.

archived.description: True if the story is archived, otherwise false.

deadline.description: The due date of the story.

estimate.description: The numeric point estimate of the story. Can also be null, which means unestimated.

project_id.description: The ID of the project the story belongs to.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to associate with this story.

story_type.description: The type of story (feature, bug, chore).

follower_ids.description: An array of UUIDs of the followers of this story.

custom_fields.description: A map specifying a CustomField ID and CustomFieldEnumValue ID.

external_links.description: An array of External Links associated with this story.

file_ids.description: An array of IDs of files attached to the story.

linked_file_ids.description: An array of IDs of linked files attached to the story.

pull_request_ids.description: An array of IDs of Pull/Merge Requests attached to the story.

requested_by_id.description: The ID of the member that requested the story.

started_at_override.description: A manual override for the time/date the Story was started.

completed_at_override.description: A manual override for the time/date the Story was completed.

after_id.description: The ID of the story we want to move this story after.

before_id.description: The ID of the story we want to move this story before.

branch_ids.description: An array of IDs of Branches attached to the story.

commit_ids.description: An array of IDs of Commits attached to the story.

sub_tasks.description: An array of story IDs to attach to this story as sub-tasks.

id.description: UUID of the custom field enum value
